adaptation.algorithm_identity: allowedAlgorithm pins the factory to outputs.Algorithms.BirchSgd.birch, i.e. Algorithm 1 run on the supplied computation tree with the source step size.
adaptation.cost: Headline: K main-branch iterations. Execution: one oracle call per framework step (one stochastic gradient computation), and node branch K exists after branch K steps; the budget is branch(⌈bound⌉₊).
adaptation.output: Theorem 2.4 bounds the average over k < K of E||grad f(x^k)||^2; the public output is x^ι for an independent uniform index ι in Fin (K+1), whose expected squared gradient equals that average (uniform_prefix_accuracy).
adaptation.probability: Product of the uniform output index and an arbitrary tape law P on ℕ → Ω whose coordinates have law μ; Condition 1 is assumed for the realised vectors under P, as in the source.
adaptation.public_information: The algorithm receives d, x0, the tree and main branch (the chosen method), the tuned step size stepSize L σ ε R and horizon K; it never sees f, the lower bound or the sample law.
adaptation.source_correspondence: main_theorem states Theorem 2.4 exactly (with the exact gap Δ = f(x0) - f^*); birch_success derives the public contract from it.

deferred_obligations.requirement: main_theorem must state Theorem 2.4 with the source step size, the source K bound and the source conclusion, proved under Assumptions 1.1-1.3 and Conditions 1-3.
execute_birch: template execution of birch with budget branch K returns node branch(i) of the realised tree for every seed index i <= K.
birch_success: spec.successful holds for the actual execution with budget branch(horizon) under the product law; the public wrapper only cites it.

parameters.justification: Dimension of R^d, needed to form points; the algorithm works in R^d.
Supplied smoothness constant of Assumption 1.1; the source step size uses it.
Supplied variance bound of Assumption 1.3; the source step size uses it.
Requested accuracy of E||grad f||^2 <= ε.
Supplied upper bound on f(x0) - f^*; the source horizon K depends on Δ = f(x0) - f^*, here a known upper bound.
Condition 3's bound on the tree distance of the chosen method; it is a property of the method's computation tree (checked in valid via DistanceBounded) and enters the source step size.

The computation tree (choices of w_base, w_grad and gradient used per step) selects which SGD method of the Birch framework is run; Theorem 2.4 quantifies over all such methods satisfying Conditions 2-3.

detail.construction: Points live in Point d = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) (LongTails Rennala model). PROB: gradientOracle P g is the template oracle with tape law P on ℕ → Ω answering a query x by g x (tape k); EpsStationary f x P ε is the Prop 'E||grad f(x)||^2 is integrable and <= ε'. TREE: structure Tree with base, point, grad : ℕ → ℕ; step j creates node j+1 from node base j, evaluates one stochastic gradient (call j) at node point j, and weights the new edge by the stochastic gradient of call grad j; WellFormed requires base j, point j, grad j <= j (only already computed points/gradients). Tree.foldHist/Tree.fold implement recursion over parents (value at node j+1 = step j (value at base j)). DREPR: Tree.repr j = multiset of call indices on the root path (grad j ::ₘ repr (base j)). DDIST: Tree.depth, Tree.ancestors (root path incl. the node), Tree.dist y z = max over the two depths minus the depth of the deepest common ancestor. DBRANCH: Tree.IsMainBranch m (m 0 = 0, node m (k+1) is a child of node m k); Tree.auxSample m k = grad (m (k+1) - 1) (the call whose gradient moves x^k to x^{k+1}) and Tree.auxNode m k = point of that call (z^k). ALG: Hist (nodes, replies), Hist.step (one framework step: store reply of call k, create node k+1 = node (base k) - gamma • reply (grad k)); Tree.realize/Tree.vertex/Tree.reply give the realised tree as functions of the sample tape; stepSize L σ ε R = min of 1/(2L), 1/(2RL) (omitted when R = 0) and ε/(4σ²L) (omitted when σ = 0); horizon = ⌈4(R+1)LΔ/ε + 8σ²LΔ/ε²⌉₊; Public (d, gamma, x0, tree, branch, K); State (count, hist, chosen); birch q is the OracleTemplate.Algorithm whose seed is a uniform index in Fin (K+1), that queries node point(count), updates by Hist.step and outputs node branch(chosen).
edge_cases: R = 0 and σ = 0 handled by explicit if-branches in stepSize (extended-real +infinity convention of the source).
Ill-formed trees are excluded by Tree.WellFormed in the setup's valid predicate; definitions are total anyway.
dist uses the deepest common ancestor; nodes are their own ancestors so dist(x, x) = 0.

Params: d, L, σ, ε, Δ, R, x0, tree, branch. publicInput computes gamma := stepSize L σ ε R and K := horizon L σ ε Δ R. spec: numOracles 1, Instance p := Rennala.Instance p.d (f and a lower bound f^*), Query = Reply = Output = Point d; valid: 0 < L, 0 <= σ, 0 < ε, 0 <= Δ, 0 <= R, WellFormed tree, IsMainBranch, ReprContained, DistanceBounded; admissible: SmoothObjective f L, LowerBounded f lower, f x0 - lower <= Δ, and there exist a sample space Ω, a sample law μ, a tape law P on ℕ → Ω and g with every tape coordinate of law μ, IsStochasticGradient μ f g σ (A3), SampleIndependent at the tuned gamma (C1), and O = gradientOracle P g; successful: Measurable output ∧ Integrable ‖grad f(output)‖^2 ∧ ∫ ‖grad f(output)‖^2 ≤ ε inline; allowedAlgorithm q A := A = birch q.

detail.construction: main_theorem is the raw Theorem 2.4: for f, L, σ, ε, R, f^*, x0, tree, main branch, μ, P, g with Assumptions 1.1-1.3 (SmoothObjective, LowerBounded, IsStochasticGradient, marginals), WellFormed/IsMainBranch, Conditions 1-3, every natural K >= 4(R+1)L(f x0 - f^*)/ε + 8σ²L(f x0 - f^*)/ε² gives integrability of ||grad f(x^k)||^2 and (1/K) Σ_{k<K} E||grad f(x^k)||^2 <= ε with gamma = stepSize. Supporting lemmas in dependency order: tree combinatorics (fold/repr/depth/ancestors recursion, vertex = x0 - γ Σ repr, main-branch facts, tree_gap: z^k = x^k + γ Σ_{i∈I} g(z^i, ξ^i) for some I ⊆ [p, k) with k - p <= R, the source identity eq:ITXwDTcpKnui with eq:VIHiAoGKxHvVihzN); probability (indep_comp/indep_bound/indep_integral: integrals of Φ(W, Y) with Y ⟂ W; measurability of the realised tree; past_* representations used with Condition 1; moments: second moments by induction); descent_point/expected_step: the one-step bound of the source before using γ <= 1/(2L), i.e. with coefficient γ/2(1 - Lγ) on E||grad f(z^k)||^2; noise_sum: E||Σ_{I} (g(z^i, ξ^i) - grad f(z^i))||^2 <= |I| σ²; delay_bound: E||x^k - z^k||^2 <= 2γ²|I|(Σ_I E||grad f(z^i)||^2 + σ²); window_sum (each index is in at most R windows), stepSize_facts, poly_case/final_combination/young_split/assembly (refined combination proving the stated constants); execution: branch_mono, advance_birch, execute_birch (template execution with budget branch K returns node branch(i)) and birch_success (successful for the uniform output, used by the public wrapper).
edge_cases: R = 0: tree_gap gives an empty window, so z^k = x^k (handled in assembly).
Regimes of the min in stepSize: each of Lγ = 1/2, LγR = 1/2, Lγσ²/ε = 1/4 is handled in poly_case.
